proof_body:
by
  intro a x ha1 ha2 hx1 hx2
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  by_cases h : x ≤ Real.pi / 2
  · have hm := Real.strictMonoOn_sin.le_iff_le (a := a) (b := x) ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ ⟨hx1, h⟩
    rw [hm]
    constructor
    · intro hax
      exact ⟨hax, by linarith⟩
    · exact fun hc => hc.1
  · have h' : Real.pi / 2 < x := not_le.mp h
    have hm := Real.strictMonoOn_sin.le_iff_le (a := a) (b := Real.pi - x) ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rw [Real.sin_pi_sub] at hm
    rw [hm]
    constructor
    · intro hax
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · intro hc
      linarith [hc.2]
target_source: ∀ a x : ℝ, -(Real.pi / 2) ≤ a → a ≤ Real.pi / 2 → -(Real.pi / 2) ≤ x → x ≤ 3 * Real.pi / 2 → (Real.sin a ≤ Real.sin x ↔ a ≤ x ∧ x ≤ Real.pi - a)
